<div class="card-body">
'''DS-61-2''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ＤＳ－６１－２</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">彼の操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋３。ブラック２に乗っている場合、回避値＋１となる上に、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、１枚引ける。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">パイロットＤＳ－６１－２号。ブラック２を駆り、ベイダー機との編隊で左翼を務める。ベイダーと共同で戦闘するための特殊訓練を受けており通常は待機している。別名“砕き屋ミゼル”。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' DS-61-2.

'''Card text:''' Any starship he pilots is power +3. While aboard Black 2, maneuver is +1, and he may draw one battle destiny even if otherwise unable to draw one.

'''Lore:''' Pilot DS-61-2. He flies Black 2 as the left wingman in formation with Vader's craft. Specially trained to fight alongside Vader, he normally stands by in reserve. Also known as “Crusher Mithel.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore renders his nickname as “Crusher Mithel”; the English calls him “Mauler Mithel.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[DS-61-2]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=144s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 2:24.</ref>
